title: Surface Areas and Volumes
subtitle: Understanding 3D Shapes and their Measurements
subject: Mathematics
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Calculate lateral and total surface area of cubes and cuboids.
Calculate the curved and total surface area of cylinders and cones.
Calculate the surface area of spheres and hemispheres.
Calculate the volume of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, and spheres.
Apply formulas to solve real-world measurement problems.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the formulas and applications of surface areas and volumes for various 3D shapes.
common_misconceptions: Confusing lateral surface area with total surface area.
Using diameter instead of radius in formulas.
Applying 2D area concepts directly to 3D volume.
Mixing up units (e.g., using cm^2 for volume instead of cm^3).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always encourage students to draw the 3D shape, label dimensions, and check units before applying formulas.
